message.content:
London’s official time zone is **Europe/London**.  
* During standard time (roughly late October – late March) it follows **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**, which is **UTC + 0**.  
* In daylight‑saving months (late March – late October) it switches to **British Summer Time (BST)**, which is **UTC + 1**.

So depending on the date you’re looking at, London will be either GMT (UTC + 0) or BST (UTC + 1).
